name: content-relay
description: Local development environment for the Content Relay WordPress plugin.

scripts.build: rm -rf build && mkdir -p build/content-relay && rsync -a --exclude-from=.distignore ./ build/content-relay/ && cd build && zip -qr content-relay.zip content-relay
scripts.plugin-check: npm run build && wp-env run cli wp plugin check /var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/content-relay/build/content-relay
scripts.test:integration: wp-env run cli wp db query 'CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS content_relay_tests' && wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/content-relay vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist
